title: rk-choi-complete-positivity: complete-positivity regions of Runge-Kutta discretizations of phase-covariant qubit dynamics (code and data)
description: Exact symbolic calculations, certified root brackets, an independent first-principles verifier of the article's claims, the Richardson-extrapolation corollary of the signed first-defect law, candidate-map tests, pointwise transverse-field certificates, certified adaptive-guard telemetry, deterministic figures and tables with accessibility audits, and regression tests supporting finite-step complete-positivity classifications of Runge-Kutta discretizations of phase-covariant qubit Lindblad dynamics. The current tree is in bit/; the root src/, data/, figures/ and supplement/ directories preserve the earlier zero-precession release v1.0.0 unchanged.
